name: Črna na Koroškem Bridge
description: Demonstration pilot of the CIRCUIT project, planned by the Municipality of Črna na Koroškem with ZAG. A new bridge over the Meža is to reuse the girders of the bridge damaged in the August 2023 floods, with abutments of reinforced soil made from flood deposits, a modular superstructure designed for dismantling and a digitally fabricated safety railing. On 1 October 2025 the bridge was still announced as a future structure.
history: ZAG reported on 26 April 2024 that the bridge will be built in cooperation between the Municipality of Črna na Koroškem and ZAG, after the CIRCUIT consortium visited the site. The local tourist office wrote on 1 October 2025 that the municipality will set up the bridge to link the buildings Center 2 to 4 with the regional road, and presented the project on the Meža bridge at Center 4 on 7 October 2025. The bridge over the Meža opened on 7 September 2025 is a different structure, since the CIRCUIT bridge was still planned after that date.

source_differences: Road number/street not found. Record 'carries: Local road' is consistent with a municipal client but unconfirmed.

Site: the map marker on the CIRCUIT pilot page (46.47286, 14.85117) lies about 350 m from the street Center in OpenStreetMap, while the tourist office places the bridge by the buildings Center 2 to 4.
Girders: ZAG wrote in April 2024 that the girders of the flood damaged bridge will be reused, while the 2024 ZAG book speaks of girders recovered from a bridge for demolition.

Wording: "designed for dismantling" and "digitally fabricated safety railing" are not in the listed sources. The pilot page speaks of a modular prefabricated superstructure, 3D printing and a safety wall.
open_question: the exact site of the bridge and whether it has been built since October 2025.
